English: The mortality of patients with confirmed cases was 1.44% (95% CI: 1.10-1.86%), and the adjusted mortality of all the patients was 3.06% (95% CI: 2.02-4.59%).

English: Ji, et al., proposed snakes as a carrier of the virus from bats to humans which involved homologous recombination within the S protein.
Kiswahili: Ji na wenzake, walipendekeza nyoka kuwa wabebaji virusi kutoka kwa popo hadi kwa binadamu jambo lililohusisha ujumuishaji tena unaofanana ndani ya protini ya S.

English: CD4+ T cells stimulate B cells to produce virus-specific antibodies, and CD8+ T cells directly kill virus-infected cells.
Kiswahili: Seli za T za aina ya CD4+ huchochea seli za B kuzalisha antibodi zinazokabiliana na virusi mahususi na seli aina ya T za CD8+ huuwa seli zilizoathirika na virusi moja kwa moja.

English: Nevertheless, short courses of corticosteroids at low-to-moderate doses have been recommended to be used prudently for critically ill COVID-19 patients.
Kiswahili: Licha ya hayo, viwango vidogo vya corticosteroids vya dozi ya chini hadi ya wastani imependekezwa kutumika ipasavyo kutibu wagonjwa walio katika hali mbaya wa COVID-19.

English: Top cure rates in the treatment of COVID-19 patients were observed in several provinces in China that used TCM in 87% of their patients, including Gansu (63.7%), Ningxia (50%), and Hunan (50%), whereas Hubei province, which used TCM in only approximately 30% of its COVID-19 patients, had the lowest cure rate (13%).
Kiswahili: Viwango vya juu vya tiba katika matibabu ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19 vilionekana katika mikoa nyingi nchini China iliyotumia TCM kutibu 87% ya wagonjwa wao, ikiwa ni pamoja na Gansu (63.7%), Ningxia (50%) na Hunan (50%), Huku mkoa wa Hubei, ambapo TCM ilitumika kwa takriban 30% pekee ya wagonjwa wao wa COVID-19, ulikuwa na kiwango cha chini zaidi cha tiba kwa (13%).

English: Abnormal laboratory findings: The C-reactive protein (CRP) level in blood reflects the severity of inflammation or tissue injury and has been proposed to be a potential prognostic factor for disease, response to therapy, and ultimate recovery.

English: Great efforts are currently underway in China including the lockdown of Wuhan and surrounding cities and continuous quarantine of almost the entire population in hopes of interrupting the transmission of SARS-CoV-2.
Kiswahili: Juhudi kubwa zinaendelea kwa sasa nchini China ikiwa ni pamoja na kufungwa kwa shughuli za kawaida mjini Wuhan na miji iliyo karibu na kuendeleza karantini kwa karibu watu wote kwa matumaini ya kukatisha usambazaji wa SARS-CoV-2.

English: Paul Hunter, et al., estimated that COVID-19, which seems substantially more infectious than SARS, will not end in 2020.
Kiswahili: Paul Hunter na wenzake, walikadiria kwamba COVID-19, ambao kimsingi unaonekana kuambukiza zaidi ya SARS, hautaisha mwaka wa 2020.
hypothesis: Paul Hunter, et al., alikadiria kuwa COVID-19, ambayo inaonekana kuwa na maambukizi zaidi kuliko SARS, haitaisha mwaka 2020.

English: For the general public in affected or potentially affected areas, it is highly suggested that everybody wash their hands with disinfectant soaps more often than usual, try to stay indoors for self-quarantine and limit contact with potentially infected individuals.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla ya umma katika maeneo yaliyoathirika au yaliyo na uwezekano wa kuathirika, inapendekezwa sana kwamba kila mtu aoshe mikono yake kwa kutumia sabuni ya kusafisha nyingi kuliko kawaida, jaribu kukaa nyumbani kwa karantini ya kibinafsi na kupunguza kugusana na watu ambao huenda wameambukizwa.

English: The disease control agencies in China may take this hard lesson and make critical improvements in the future.

English: The other five beta-CoVs include HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS-CoV), Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) and SARS-CoV-2.
Kiswahili: Aina nyingine tano za beta-CoV ni pamoja na HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, virusi vya korona (SARS-CoV) vya sindromu hatari kali ya kupumua, Virusi vya korona vya sindromu ya kupumua vya Mashariki ya Kati (MERS-CoV) na SARS-CoV-2.

English: The first HCoV-229E strain, B814, was isolated from the nasal discharge of patients with common cold in mid-1960s.
Kiswahili: Aina ya kwanza ya HCoV-229E, B814, ilitolewa kutoka kwa majimaji yatokayo puani za wagonjwa waliokuwa na homa ya kawaida katikati ya miaka ya 1960.

English: Patients infected with HCoV-229E presented with common cold symptoms, including headache, sneezing, malaise and sore-throat, with fever and cough seen in 10~20% cases.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa walioambukizwa HCoV-229E walionyesha dalili za homa ya kawaida, ikiwa ni pamoja na maumivu ya kichwa, kupiga chafya, uchovu na koo inayouma, huku joto jingi na kikohozi kikionekana katika visa 10~20%.

English: For many years, the four community-acquired CoVs circulate in human populations, triggering common cold in immunocompetent subjects.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi, virusi vinne vya CoV vinavyoenezwa kijamii vimesambaa miongoni mwa watu, na kuchochea homa ya kawaida miongoni mwa watu/wanyama walio na kinga thabiti.

English: An animal serves as the evolutionary host of an HCoV if it harbours a closely related ancestor sharing high homology at the level of nucleotide sequence.
Kiswahili: Mnyama hutumika kama kibebaji cha HCoV cha kiukuaji ikiwa amehifadhi ukoo wa karibu unaofanana katika kiwango cha mfululizo wa nukliotidi.

English: However, it has been reported that masked palm civets from the wild or farms without exposure to the live animal markets were largely negative for SARS-CoV, suggesting that masked palm civets might only serve as the intermediate amplifying host but not the natural reservoir of SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, imeripotiwa kwamba ngawa wenye uso wenye barakoa kutoka porini au mashambani bila kutangamana na wanyama wanaouzwa sokoni wengi wao hawakupatikana na SARS-CoV, na kuashiria kwamba ngawa wenye uso wa barakao wanaweza tu kutumika kama wabebaji wa kati wa kueneza lakini sio hifadhi asili wa SARS-CoV.

English: Thus far, WIV1 represents the most closely related ancestor of SARS-CoV in bats, sharing 95% nucleotide sequence homology.
Kiswahili: Kufikia sasa, virusi vya WIV1 vinawakilisha kizazi cha karibu sana cha SARS-CoV kwenye popo, vikiwa na 95% za msururu wa nukleotidi unaofanana.

English: Whereas the highest sequence homology has been found in the RBDs between SARS-CoV-2 and pangolin, SARS-CoV-2-related beta-CoVs, SARS-CoV-2 and RaTG13 share the highest genome-wide sequence homology.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mfanano wa juu zaidi wa msururu umepatikana kwenye RBD kati ya beta-CoV vinavyohusiana na SARS-CoV-2 na SARS-CoV-2 vilivyopatikana kwa kakakuona, SARS-CoV-2 na RaTG13 vina mfanano wa juu wa msururu wa jinomu.

English: Several lines of evidence support the transmission of virus from bats to humans directly.
Kiswahili: Mistari kadhaa ya ushahidi huunga mkono usambazaji wa virusi wa moja kwa moja kutoka kwa popo hadi kwa binadamu.
hypothesis: Mstari kadhaa wa ushahidi unasaidia usambazaji wa virusi kutoka kwa popo hadi kwa binadamu moja kwa moja.

English: On the other hand, MERS-CoV has been introduced to dromedary camels for decades.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mwingine, virusi vya MERS-CoV vimekuwa ndani ya ngamia warefu kwa muda wa miongo.
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, MERS-CoV imewasilishwa kwa ngamia wadudu kwa miongo kadhaa.

English: Several possibilities for interspecies transmission of SARS-CoV-2 from animals to humans have to be ruled in or ruled out in future studies.
Kiswahili: Uwezekano kadhaa wa usambazaji wa SARS-CoV-2 baina ya viumbe kutoka kwa wanyama hadi kwa binadamu lazima uweze kukubalika au kukataliwa katika utafiti wa sku zijazo.

English: Third, CoVs randomly and frequently switch templates during RNA replication through a unique “copy-choice” mechanism.
Kiswahili: Tatu, CoV bila mpangilio na mara kwa mara hubadili kiolezo wakati wa uzalishaji wa RNA kupitia utaratibu maalum wa "copy-choice".

English: Recombination locations were also identified in the nsp9, most of nsp10, and parts of nsp14.

English: As we are not able to eliminate these viruses, new genotypes might emerge to cause outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hatuwezi kuondoa virusi hivi, aina mpya inaweza kuibuka na kusababisha mikurupuko.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa hatuwezi kuondoa virusi hivi, genotipi mpya zinaweza kuibuka kusababisha mkurupuko.

English: Particularly, bat CoVs with zoonotic potential are so diverse.
Kiswahili: Hususan, virusi vya CoV vinavyosababishwa na popo vyenye uwezo wa kusambazwa na wanyama ni anuwai mno.
hypothesis: Hasa, virusi vya CoV vya popo vilivyo na uwezo wa kuambukiza wanyama ni tofauti sana.

English: The RCGP RSC and PHE have an established collaboration of over 50 years in influenza and respiratory disease surveillance and are now in their 53rd season of surveillance and analysis.
Kiswahili: RCGP RSC na PHE zimeshirikiana kwa zaidi ya miaka 50 katika uchunguzi wa homa ya mafua na magonjwa ya pumu na sasa zimo katika msimu wao wa 53 wa uchunguzi na uchanganuzi.

English: We also produce an annual report.
Kiswahili: Pia tunatoa ripoti ya kila mwaka.
hypothesis: Pia tunatoa ripoti ya kila mwaka.

English: Nasopharyngeal swabs are taken from children younger than 5 years showing symptoms of acute bronchitis or bronchiolitis.
Kiswahili: Chembe zinazotolewa puani kutoka kwa watoto walio na umri wa chini ya miaka 5 zinaoonyesha dalili za ugonjwa sugu wa mikamba ya kupumua.

English: With the COVID-19 outbreak, PHE and RCGP RSC have adapted existing influenza surveillance to monitor the spread of COVID-19 in the community, and this protocol sets out the basis for that collaboration.
Kiswahili: Kukiwa na mkurupuko wa COVID-19, PHE na RCGP RSC zimeanza kutumia uchunguzi uliopo wa homa ya mafua ili kufuatilia kuenea kwa COVID-19 katika jamii na utaratibu huu unaweka bayana msingi wa ushirikiano huo.

English: We would not be working in isolation on this research.
Kiswahili: Hatutafanya kazi pekee yetu katika utafiti huu.

English: A UK emergency release of SNOMED CT concepts for COVID-19 was also subsequently made available across all CMR systems (Table 4).

hypothesis: Toleo la dharura la Uingereza la dhana za SNOMED CT kwa ajili ya COVID-19 pia lilipatikana baadaye katika mifumo yote ya CMR (Jedwali la 4).

English: Possible cases will be presented as “Under investigation” (investigating).
Kiswahili: Visa vinavyowezekana vitawasilishwa kama "Vinavyochunguzwa" (kuchunguza).
hypothesis: Visa vinavyowezekana vitatolewa kama "chini ya uchunguzi" (unachunguzwa).

English: Practice reception or triage staff: for coding of any patients calling the practice with symptoms of acute respiratory infection with a history of travel to important areas based on PHE advice
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wapokezi katika huduma: kwa ajili ya usimbaji wa wagonjwa wowote wanaokuja kwenye huduma na dalili za maambukizi mabaya ya pumu walio na historia ya kusafiri katika maeneo muhimu kulingana na ushauri wa PHE

English: To implement this the UK government has recently articulated the desire to implement population self-isolation measures.
Kiswahili: Ili kutekeleza haya, serikali ya Uingereza hivi majuzi imeeleza nia ya kutekeleza hatua za kuwatenga watu kibinfasi.

English: Since we are fitting an SIR-epidemic model in the ABC routine, we anticipate that our results will be robust against weekly case data containing relatively small counts.
Kiswahili: Kwa vile tunaweka muundo wa janga wa SIR katika utarbitbu wa ABC, tunatarajia kwamba matokeo yetu yatakuwa makubwa yakilinganishwa na data ya kila wiki iliyo na idadi ndogo.

English: Infection prevention and control advice will follow extant national guidance.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa uzuiaji na udhibiti wa maambukizi utafuata mwongozo uliopo wa kitaifa.

English: This includes information on coding of clinical descriptors (Table 4) and any recent travel history.
Kiswahili: Hii ni pamoja na maelezo kuhusu usimbaji wa maelezo ya kimatibabu (Jedwali la 4) na historia yoyote ya usafiri hivi majuzi.

English: The impact on practices has been to close for a day, if a case is found, for deep cleaning and then reopen.
Kiswahili: Kisa kikipatikana, athari kwa huduma imekuwa kufungwa kwa siku nzima kwa ajili ya usafi wa kina kisha kufungua tena.
hypothesis: Athari kwa vitendo imekuwa kufungwa kwa siku, ikiwa kesi imepatikana, kwa usafishaji wa kina na kisha kufunguliwa tena.

English: Hence, the flow chart of Zhou et al. should be updated, as they classified the person without clinical symptoms as “low risk”.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, chati ya Zhou na wenzake inapaswa kusasishwa, kwa sababu iliainisha mtu bila dalili za kimatibabu kuwa ni wa “hatari ya chini”.

Kiswahili: Kukamilisha, tunatumai ushahidi wa moja kwa moja zaidi utaibuka na tunawarai wasomaji kutoa maoni yao.

Kiswahili: Kwa upimaji wa "kisa kinachoshukiwa" na "kisa kilichothibitishwa", tunapendekeza kufuatwa na utiifu wa miongozo mipya ya nchi zao za nyumbani.

Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi wa Taasisi ya Kitaifa wa Mzio na Ugonjwa wa Kuambukiza, Dkt. Anthony Fauci, alisema kuhusu kuzuka kwa ugonjwa, "cha msingi, inaenda kuwa mbaya zaidi."

English: For those who do not, the time from development of symptoms to death has been between 6 and 41 days, with the most common being 14 days.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale ambao hawaponi, muda kutoka kuonekana kwa dalili hadi kifo imekuwa kati ya siku 6 na 41, nambari za siku ya kawaida ikiwa 14.

English: The number varies by region.
Kiswahili: Idadi inatofautiana kulingana na eneo.

English: But it's almost impossible to make any sensible projection right now about when that will be".

English: People have tested positive for the disease up to three days before onset of symptoms suggesting transmission is possible before developing significant symptoms.
Kiswahili: Watu wamepimwa na kupatikana chanya kwa ugonjwa hadi siku tatu kabla ya kuonekana kwa dalili inaonyesha kuwa kusambazwa inawezekana kabla dalili nyingi hazijatokea.

English: Singapore provided financial support for those infected who quarantined themselves and imposed large fines for those who failed to do so.
Kiswahili: Singapore ilitoa msaada wa kifedha kwa wale walioambukizwa na waliojiweka karantini na kutoza faini kubwa kwa wale waliokosa kufanya hivyo.
hypothesis: Singapore ilitoa msaada wa kifedha kwa wale walioambukizwa ambao walijitenga na kuweka faini kubwa kwa wale walioshindwa kufanya hivyo.

English: Taiwan increased face mask production and penalized hoarding of medical supplies.Simulations for Great Britain and the United States show that mitigation (slowing but not stopping epidemic spread) and suppression (reversing epidemic growth) have major challenges.
Kiswahili: Taiwan iliongeza utengenezaji wa barakoa za uso na kutoza faini kwa kuhodhi bidhaa za kimatibabu.
hypothesis: Taiwan iliongeza uzalishaji wa barakoa za uso na kukabiliwa na adhabu ya kuhifadhi vifaa vya kimatibabu.Vipimo vya Uingereza na Marekani vinaonyesha kwamba kupunguza (kulegeza kasi lakini kutozuia kuenea kwa janga) na kudhibiti (kugeuza ukuaji wa janga) kuna changamoto kubwa.

English: The WHO also stated that some "traditional and home remedies" can provide relief of the symptoms caused by SARS-CoV-19.
Kiswahili: WHO pia ilitaja kwamba "baadhi ya suluhu za kienyeji na za nyumbani" zinaweza kutoa nafuu kwa dalili zinazosababishwa na SARS-CoV-19.
hypothesis: WHO pia ilisema kwamba baadhi ya "matibabu ya jadi na ya nyumbani" yanaweza kutoa upungufu wa dalili zinazosababishwa na SARS-CoV-19.

English: Increasing capacity and adapting healthcare for the needs of COVID-19 patients is described by the WHO as a fundamental outbreak response measure.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza nafasi na kubadilisha huduma za afya kwa mahitaji ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19 inaelezwa na WHO kama hatua ya msingi ya kukabiliana na kuzuka kwa ugonjwa.

English: The regions of Hong Kong and Macau instituted several measures, particularly in regard to schools and universities.
Kiswahili: Maeneo ya Hong Kong na Macau yaliweka hatua kadhaa, hasa kuhusiana na shule na vyuo vikuu.
hypothesis: Mikoa ya Hong Kong na Macau ilianzisha hatua kadhaa, hasa kuhusiana na shule na vyuo vikuu.

English: The Chinese government encouraged businesses and factories to re-open on 30 March, and provided monetary stimulus packages for firms.The State Council declared a day of mourning to begin with a national three-minute moment of silence on 10:00 4 April, coinciding with Qingming Festival, although the central government asked families to pay their respects online in observance of physical distancing as to avoid a renewed COVID-19 outbreak.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Uchina ilihimiza biashara na viwanda kufunguwa mnamo 30 Machi, na kutoa msaada wa kifedha kuimarisha biashara.Kamati ya Serikali ilitangaza siku ya majonzi kuanzia na muda wa ukimya wa dakika tatu saa 4:00 4 Aprili, ikisadifiana na Sherehe ya Qingming, ingawa serikali ya kati iliwaomba familia kuomboleza mtandaoni kuzuia kutokea tena kwa mkurupuko wa COVID-19.
hypothesis: Serikali ya Uchina ilihimiza biashara na viwanda kufungua tena tarehe 30 Machi, na kutoa vifurushi vya msukumo wa kifedha kwa ajili ya makampuni.Baraza la Jimbo lilitangaza siku ya maombolezo ili kuanza na muda wa utulivu wa dakika tatu wa kitaifa tarehe 10:00 tarehe 4 Aprili, ikilinganishwa na Tamasha la Qingming, ingawa serikali kuu iliomba familia kutoa heshima zao mtandaoni kwa kuzingatia umbali wa kimwili ili kuepuka mkurupuko mpya wa COVID-19.

English: The nation's health agency reported a significant increase in confirmed cases on 20 February, largely attributed to a gathering in Daegu of a new religious movement known as the Shincheonji Church of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Shirika la afya ya nchi ilitangaza kuongezeka kubwa katika visa vilivyothibitishwa mnamo 20 Februari, ikihusishwa pakubwa na mkutano Daegu la kundi mpya ya kidini inayojulikana kama Kanisa la Yesu ya Shincheonji.

English: On 12 March, the Human Rights Watch urged the Iranian prison authorities to unconditionally release the human rights defenders detained for peaceful dissent, and to also temporarily release all the eligible prisoners.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 12 Machi, Shirika la Haki za Kibinadamu ilihimiza mamlaka ya jela ya Irani kuwaachilia bila masharti wanaotetea haki za kibinadamu waliokamatwa kwa upinzani wa amani, na pia kuachilia kwa muda wafungwa wote wanaostahili.
hypothesis: Tarehe 12 Machi, Human Rights Watch iliwasihi mamlaka za gerezani za Irani kuwaachilia bila masharti watetezi wa haki za binadamu waliokamatwa kwa sababu ya kupinga amani, na pia kuwaachilia kwa muda wafungwa wote wanaostahiki.

English: On 15 March, the Iranian government reported 100 deaths in a single day, the most recorded in the country since the outbreak began.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 15 Machi, serikali ya Irani ilitangaza vifo 100 katika siku moja, nambari ya juu zaidi iliyorekodiwa nchini tangu mkurupuko ulianza.
hypothesis: Tarehe 15 Machi, serikali ya Irani iliripoti vifo 100 kwa siku moja, kiwango cha juu zaidi katika nchi tangu mkurupuko huo ulianza.

English: According to a WHO official, there may be five times more cases in Iran than what is being reported.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na ofisa wa WHO, kunawezekana kuwa visa tano zaidi Irani kuliko vinavyoripotiwa.
hypothesis: Kulingana na afisa wa WHO, kunaweza kuwa na visa zaidi ya mara tano nchini Iran kuliko ilivyoripotiwa.

English: On 22 March, it was reported that Russia had sent nine military planes with medical equipment to Italy.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 22 Machi, iliripotiwa kuwa Urusi ilituma ndege tisa ya kijeshi na vifaa vya kimatibabu kuelekea Italia.
hypothesis: Tarehe 22 Machi, iliripotiwa kwamba Urusi ilituma ndege tisa za kijeshi zilizo na vifaa vya kimatibabu hadi Italia.

English: As a result, the government received criticism for the perceived lack of pace and intensity in its response to concerns faced by the public.On 16 March, Prime Minister Boris Johnson made an announcement advising against all non-essential travel and social contact, suggesting people work from home where possible and avoid venues such as pubs, restaurants, and theatres.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hiyo, serikali ililaumiwa kwa mwonekano wa kulegea katika harakati ya kushughulika na wasiwasi iliyokabiliwa na umma.Mnamo 16 Machi, Waziri Mkuu Boris Johnson alitoa tangazo akishauri dhidi ya kusafiri kusikohitajika na kutangamana kijamii, alipendekeza watu wafanye kazi kutoka nyumbani inapowezekana na kuepuka maeneo kama vilabu, hoteli, na sinema.
hypothesis: Matokeo yake, serikali ilipokea ukosoaji kwa sababu ya kukosekana kwa kasi na nguvu katika kukabiliana na wasiwasi unaokabiliwa na umma.Mnamo 16 Machi, Waziri Mkuu Boris Johnson alitoa tangazo akitoa ushauri dhidi ya usafiri wote usio muhimu na mawasiliano ya kijamii, akipendekeza watu kufanya kazi kutoka nyumbani inapohitajika na kuepuka maeneo kama vile baa, mikahawa, na ukumbi wa michezo.

English: In the state of New York the cases have exceeded 100,000 people on 3 April.The White House has been criticized for downplaying the threat and controlling the messaging by directing health officials and scientists to coordinate public statements and publications related to the virus with the office of Vice-President Mike Pence.
Kiswahili: Katika jimbo la New York visa vilikuwa zaidi ya watu 100,000 mnamo 3 Aprili.Ikulu ya Marekani imeshutumiwa kwa kutotilia maanani tishio na kudhibiti ujumbe ya maafisa wa afya na wanasayansi kusimamia taarifa ya umma na machapisho yanayohusiana na virusi na ofisi ya Naibu wa Rais Mike Pence.

English: Dubai, Sydney, and Melbourne were also reported as popular destinations for people travelling from Wuhan.
Kiswahili: Dubai, Sydney, na Melbourne pia ziliripotiwa kama vituo vipendavyo ya watu wanaosafiri kutoka Wuhan.

English: On 15 February, the United States announced that it would evacuate Americans aboard the cruise ship Diamond Princess.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 15 Februari, Marekani ilitangaza kuwa ingehamisha Wamerikani walioabiri meli ya starehe ya Diamond Princess.

Kiswahili: Mwanzoni wa Machi, serikali ya Uhindi ilianza kuhamisha raia wake kutoka Irani.Mnamo 14 Machi ndege ya Shirika la ndege Afrika Kusini iliyokodishwa na serikali ya Afrika Kusini iliwarudisha nyumbani raia wa Afrika Kusini 112.

English: Tedros further made statements declaring that "we are only as strong as our weakest link" and urged the international community to "invest today or pay more later".On 11 February, the WHO in a press conference established COVID-19 as the name of the disease.
Kiswahili: Tedros alitoa taarifa zaidi akisema kuwa "tuko na nguvu tu kama kiungo chetu dhaifu" na kuhimiza jumuiya ya kimataifa "kuwekeza leo au kulipa zaidi baadaye".Tarehe 11 Februari, WHO katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari walithibitisha COVID-19 kama jina la ugonjwa.

English: The Chinese government has been criticized by the United States, UK Minister for the Cabinet Office Michael Gove, and Brazil President Jair Bolsonaro's son Eduardo Bolsonaro for its handling of the pandemic, which began in the Chinese province of Hubei.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Uchina imelaumiwa na Marekani, Waziri wa Ofisi ya Waziri Uingereza Michael Gove, na Eduardo Bolsonaro mwana wa Rais wa Brazil Jair Bolsonaro kwa kushughulikia janga hili, ambayo ilianza katika mkoa wa Uchina wa Hubei.

English: It has also caused a shortage of personal protective equipment worldwide, with the WHO warning that this will endanger health workers.
Kiswahili: Imesababisha pia ukosefu wa vifaa za kujikinga kibinafsi duniani, na WHO kuonya kuwa hii itahatarisha wafanyakazi wa afya.
hypothesis: Pia imesababisha upungufu wa vifaa vya kujikinga kibinafsi kote ulimwenguni, na WHO ikitoa tahadhari kwamba hii itakuwa hatarini kwa wafanyakazi wa afya.

English: Northern Italy with its significant agricultural production has not seen a large reduction, but prices may increase according to industry representatives.
Kiswahili: Italia Kaskazini na uzalishaji wake mkubwa wa bidhaa za kilimo haijapata upungufu mkubwa, lakini bei huenda ikapanda kulingana na wawakilishi wa viwanda.

English: As mainland China is a major economy and manufacturing hub, the viral outbreak has been seen to pose a major destabilizing threat to the global economy.
Kiswahili: Kwa vile eneo la bara la China ni kitovu kikuu cha uchumi na viwanda, mkurupuko wa virusi hivi umeonekana kusababisha athari kuu ya kuyumbisha uchumi wa kimataifa.

English: Stocks plunged again based on coronavirus fears, the largest fall being on 16 March.
Kiswahili: Mauzo ya bidhaa yalididimia tena kutokana na hofu za virusi vya korona, tarehe 16 Machi ikishuhudiwa kushukwa pakubwa zaidi.
hypothesis: Hisa zilianguka tena kulingana na hofu ya virusi vya korona, na kuanguka kubwa zaidi ilikuwa tarehe 16 Machi.

English: Many dioceses have recommended older Christians to stay at home rather than attending Mass on Sundays; some churches have made church services available via radio, online live streaming or television while others are offering drive-in worship.
Kiswahili: Dayosisi kadhaa zimependekeza Wakristo wazee kukaa nyumbani bali wasishiriki katika Misa Jumapili; kanisa zingine zimefanya ibada ya kanisa kupatikana kupitia redio, utiririshaji wa moja kwa moja mtandaoni au televisheni ilhali wengine wana ibada ya washiriki kuja garini.
hypothesis: Ekelesia nyingi zimependekeza Wakristo wazee kukaa nyumbani badala ya kuhudhuria Misa siku za Jumapili; baadhi ya makanisa yamefanya huduma za kanisa zipatikane kupitia redio, matangazo ya moja kwa moja mtandaoni au televisheni huku zingine zikitoa ibada za gari.

English: Some artists have explored ways to continue to produce and share work over the internet as an alternative to traditional live performance, such as live streaming concerts or creating web-based "festivals" for artists to perform, distribute, and publicize their work.
Kiswahili: Wasanii wengine wamejaribu njia za kuendelea kuunda na kusambaza kazi kupitia mtandao kama njia mbadala ya maonyesho ya moja kwa moja, kama vile maonyesho ya moja kwa moja mtandaoni au kuunda "tamasha" mtandaoni ya wasanii kutumbuiza watu, kusambaza, na kuendeleza kazi zao.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya wasanii wamechunguza njia za kuendelea kuzalisha na kushiriki kazi kupitia mtandao kama mbadala wa maonyesho ya jadi ya moja kwa moja, kama vile matamasha ya moja kwa moja au kuunda "maadhimisho" yanayotegemea mtandao kwa ajili ya wasanii kufanya, kusambaza, na kutangaza kazi zao.

English: There has been support for the Chinese, both on and offline, and towards those in virus-stricken areas.
Kiswahili: Kumekuwa na kuunga mikono Wachina, mtandaoni na nje, na kwa wale walio katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na virusi.
hypothesis: Kumekuwa na usaidizi kwa Wachina, wote mtandaoni na nje ya mtandao, na kuelekea wale walio katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na virusi.

English: An accurate mortality rate of the disease and the level of herd immunity in the population can be determined from the results of this test.
Kiswahili: Kiwango sahihi cha vifo vinavyosababishwa na ugonjwa huu na kiwango cha kinga kigumu cha mwili miongoni mwa watu kinaweza kubainishwa kutokana na kipimo hiki.
hypothesis: Kiwango sahihi cha vifo vya ugonjwa na kiwango cha kinga ya kundi katika idadi ya watu kinaweza kuamuliwa kutokana na matokeo ya jaribio hili.

English: Due to limited testing, as of March 2020 no countries had reliable data on the prevalence of the virus in their population.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na viwango vya chini ya upimaji, kufikia Machi 2020 hakuna nchi zilizokuwa na data ya kutegemeka kuhusu kusambaa kwa virusi miongoni mwa watu wake.
hypothesis: Kutokana na upimaji mdogo, kufikia Machi 2020 hakuna nchi zilizokuwa na data inayoaminika kuhusu kuenea kwa virusi katika idadi yao.

English: On 21 March 2020, Cepheid similarly received EUA from the FDA for a test that takes about 45 minutes.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 21 Machi 2020, Cepheid pia ilipokea idhini sawa ya EUA kutoka kwa FDA kwa kipimo kinachochukua takriban dakika 45.
hypothesis: Tarehe 21 Machi 2020, Cepheid pia alipokea EUA kutoka kwa FDA kwa ajili ya jaribio linalochukua takriban dakika 45.

English: After changing the diapers or cleaning up a child who has used the toilet.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kubadilisha nepi au kumsafisha mtoto ambaye ameenda chooni.
hypothesis: Baada ya kubadilisha diapers au kusafisha mtoto ambaye ametumia choo.

English: A small detrimental effect of hand washing is that frequent hand washing can lead to skin damage due to drying of the skin.
Kiswahili: Athari kidogo mbaya ya kuosha mikono ni kwamba kuosha mikono kila mara kunaweza kusababisha kuharibika kwa ngozi kutokana na kukauka kwa ugonjwa.
hypothesis: Athari ndogo mbaya ya kuosha mikono ni kwamba kuosha mikono mara kwa mara kunaweza kusababisha uharibifu wa ngozi kutokana na kukausha kwa ngozi.

English: A 2012 Danish study found that excessive hand washing can lead to an itchy, flaky skin condition known as hand eczema or hand dermatitis, which is especially common among health-care workers.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa nchini Denmaki wa 2012 ulionyesha kwamba kuosha mikono kupita kiasi kunaweza kusababisha hali ya mwasho wa ngozi unaofahamika kuwakizema ya mikono au ugonjwa wa ngozi ya mikojno hali zilizo za kawaida hususan miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wa matibabu.
hypothesis: Utafiti wa Denmark wa 2012 ulipata kwamba kuosha mikono kupita kiasi kunaweza kusababisha hali ya ngozi yenye kuchosha, inayojulikana kama eczema ya mikono au dermatitis ya mikono, ambayo ni ya kawaida hasa miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wa huduma ya afya.

English: Allergic contact dermatitis, contact urticaria syndrome or hypersensitivity to alcohol or additives present in alcohol hand rubs rarely occur.
Kiswahili: Matatizo ya mzio unaotakana na mguso wa ngozi, ugonjwa wa kuchubuka kwa ngozi au matatizo yanayotokana na alkoholi au viungo vilivyo kwenye vieuzi vilivyo na alkoholi hayakutokea sana.
hypothesis: Uvimbe wa ngozi wa kugusana na kingamwili, ugonjwa wa kugusana na urticaria au unyeti kupita kiasi wa pombe au viungo vinavyopatikana katika mikeka ya mikono ya pombe si mara nyingi hufanyika.

English: After drying, the paper towel should be used to turn off the water (and open any exit door if necessary).
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupangusa, tishu hizi zinafaa kutumiwa kufunga maji (na kufungua mlango wowote wa kutoka nje kama inatakikana).
hypothesis: Baada ya kukausha, taulo ya karatasi inapaswa kutumika kuzima maji (na kufungua mlango wowote wa kutoka ikiwa ni lazima).
